Overview

Cardiff is a city in Wales with a population of 362,755. Wales’ capital offers a compact, affordable city with a growing media sector, a stunning waterfront, and easy access to nature. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
